text.en:
Functions. The NLDPMO shall have the following
Provide overall coordination and monitoring of the component
programs/projects of the Updated North Luzon Development Plan
(2001-2004);
Continue the refinement of the Updated North Luzon Development
Plan (2001-2004), giving due consideration to existing development
plans, programs and projects in the area;
Perform such other functions and responsibilities as the President

Organization and Budget. The organizational structure
and staffing pattern of the NLDPMO shall be subject to the approval of the
Department of Budget and Management (DBM).
The DBM shall determine the funding for the initial operations of the
NLDPMO and obtain the same from such available sources as the DBM may
identify. Henceforth, funding for the operations of the NLDPMO shall be
included in the annual appropriations of the Department of Trade and
Industry. Fiscal austerity shall be strictly observed.

Repealing Clause. All executive orders, instructions,
rules and regulations or parts thereof which are contrary or inconsistent
with the provisions of this Executive Order are hereby modified or repealed
accordingly.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect
immediately.
City of Manila, November.
9 _, 2002.
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
